rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something breaks open from internal pressure.

example.english: The balloon burst on its own.
example.jyutping: go3 hei3 kau4 zi6 gei2 baau3 zo2

rows.note: Use this for the all-purpose noun meaning a sudden, intense display of feeling or activity.

example.english: After he said that, the whole room burst into a round of loud applause.
example.traditional: 佢講完嗰句，全場爆發一陣熱烈掌聲。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 jyun4 go2 geoi3 cyun4 coeng4 baau3 faat3 jat1 zan6 jit6 lit6 zoeng2 seng1

rows.note: Use this for an actual explosion or other sudden bursting event, especially involving bombs.

example.english: The bomb burst, shaking the whole building.
example.traditional: 炸彈突然爆炸，震到成座大廈都搖晒。
example.jyutping: zaa3 daan6 dat6 jin4 baau3 zaa3 zan3 dou3 seng4 zo6 daai6 haa6 dou1 jiu4 saai3

rows.note: Use this when someone causes an object such as a balloon to burst.

example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 zing2 baau3 go3 hei3 kau4 aa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for one burst or round of automatic gunfire.

example.english: The gunmen fired a burst at the police car, and the police immediately returned fire.
example.traditional: 武裝分子向警車發出一輪掃射，警方即刻還擊。
example.jyutping: mou5 zong1 fan1 zi2 hoeng3 ging2 ce1 faat3 ceot1 jat1 leon4 sou3 se6 ging2 fong1 zik1 hak1 waan4 gik1

rows.note: Use this for a flower suddenly coming into bloom rather than for something physically bursting.

example.english: When spring arrives, the cherry blossoms burst into bloom.
example.traditional: 春天一到，啲櫻花就開花喇。
example.jyutping: ceon1 tin1 jat1 dou3 di1 jing1 faa1 zau6 hoi1 faa1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when bursting or blasting produces a hole through something such as a wall.

example.english: The drill was so powerful it nearly burst through the whole wall.
example.traditional: 架電鑽太勁，差啲爆穿成幅牆。
example.jyutping: gaa3 din6 zyun3 taai3 ging6 caa1 di1 baau3 cyun1 seng4 fuk1 coeng4
